name: io.github.hostkey-cloud/mcp-server
description: MCP server for Hostkey .com portal (InvAPI invapi.hostkey.com): servers, power control, ordering, OS reinstall, network, DNS, S3 storage, billing

environmentVariables.name: HOSTKEY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: InvAPI API key for the .com portal (invapi.hostkey.com); per-server keys supported

environmentVariables.name: HOSTKEY_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow destructive operations (OS reinstall, PXE cycle, service cancellation)
